Name: Smart Filtered Hopper
Author: yxlimo
Description:
[b]Credits & History[/b]
I forked the Deluxe [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21730]Filtered Chest Hopper[/url] mod by Shivion , who had forked the original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9418]Super Hopper[/url] by spacechase0 to make it work better for auto pipeleines

The base code and functionality credits go to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Nykal145] [/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/TheShivion]Shivion[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/spacechase0]spacechase0[/url] — I couldn't have made the fixes and feature additions without their hard work.

[b]What does this mod do?[/b]

Easily build automation chains! Smart Hoppers move only the items you choose from upper chests to lower chests.
 
[b]Rebuilt from the ground up[/b], this successor to Filtered Chest Hopper introduces pipeline-wide filtering: the Hopper searches the entire Automate network above for player-specified items, consolidating them into the bottom chest. Perfect for distributed storage setups where item placement shouldn't break your automation.

[b]If you run into any bugs or have feature requests, please report them on this mod's page or on github [/b]

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Transfer Items [/*]
[/list][b]Configuration[/b]
If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] installed, all settings are available from the in-game options screen. Otherwise, edit config.json in the mod folder.

[b]Compatibility[/b]
[list]
[*]Works with modded items (SVE, Item Extensions, etc.)[/*]
[*]Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url] — It can read items from chests in automate pipelines[/*]
[*]Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43136]Deluxe Grabber Redux Fixes[/url]( [url=https://github.com/Rafia-Bee/StardewMods/releases/tag/DGF-v1.16.4]v1.16.4[/url]+) — Hoppers are no longer treated as chest connectors in the Automate chain scanner, so split chains work correctly [/*]
[*][b]Chest Expansion:[/b] If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30323]Unlimited Storage[/url] installed, The hopper's built-in capacity slider will not take effect, but unlimited capacity feature works perfectly on hoppers (effectively replacing the native adjustment). Other expansion mods is[b] [/b]Untested, Please let us know if you encounter any issues![/*]
[*]Safe to install and uninstall mid-playthrough[/*]
[/list][b]Workaround for Input Stock Control (Until v1.0):[/b]
Until native quantity filters arrive in v1.0, you can use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/518]Chests Anywhere[/url] to manually control input inventory. The Hopper reads [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url] 's access tags, so any restriction set via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/518]Chests Anywhere[/url] will be respected.
Simply tag a chest as [b]"Never take items from this chest"[/b] , and the Hopper will skip that chest when searching for items. This allows you to manually reserve stock in specific chests and prevent the Hopper from draining them completely.


[b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] 4.0+[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[/list][b]Optional:[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] — In-game settings menu[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/518]Chests Anywhere[/url][/*]
[/list][b]Install[/b]
[list]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Run the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][b]FAQ[/b]
[b]Can I install this mid-playthrough?[/b]
Yes. It works immediately on the next day.

[b]Credits[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/spacechase0]spacechase0[/url]  for the original Super Hopper[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Nykal145][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Nykal145][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/TheShivion]Shivion[/url]  for the Filtered Chest Hopper[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Pathoschild]Pathoschild[/url] for [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/spacechase0]spacechase0[/url] for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][/*]
[/list][b]Translations[/b]
This mod supports translations! If you'd like to translate it into your language:
[list]
[*]Copy the i18n/default.json file from the mod folder.[/*]
[*]Rename it to your [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Translations]language code[/url] (e.g. fr.json, ko.json, pt-br.json).[/*]
[*]Translate the values (not the keys) in the file.[/*]
[*]Upload only the translation file and notify me so I can include it in the mod and credit you on this page.[/*]
[/list][url=https://github.com/yxlimo/StardewValleyMods]Source Code[/url]
